scope.memory_sampling: approximately 1-second whole-card and whole-system samples; neither process nor minimum-VRAM requirement
scope.reviewer: host vision, original PNGs, no repairs; not OCR-only
scope.scoring: Exact requested strings, whitespace/line wrapping normalized. Missing plural letters or Chinese wrong radicals fail the whole string. Repeated expected occurrences scored separately and capped; unexpected repetitions are separately a contract failure. Diagram edges require unambiguous exact labeled endpoints, not inferred intended identities. Combined boxes may have readable labels but fail the node contract. Layout violations are separate from text score.
scope.evidence: Original PNGs, private job receipts and resource logs retained by operator, not published.

decision: Keep FLUX as fast visual/edit default; explicitly select Z-Image for short Chinese lettering and low-density text. Z low-text 14/18 vs FLUX 6/18, but visual usability Z 8/12 vs FLUX 10/12, with full-head crops in all four Z full-body samples. Neither passes complex diagrams/UI content contract.

flux-klein-4b.first_scope: model switch, shared encoder may remain cached; not a fully cold process
